candidates.summary: a percent-encoded CID on a retired path gateway is left alone or rewritten depending on an unrelated byte later in the path, because splitGatewayPath reads u.EscapedPath(), which returns RawPath when it is valid and re-escapes the decoded Path otherwise
candidates.failure_scenario: https://ipfs.io/ipfs/%41<cid>/a.png is untouched (TestRewriteIPFSURL pins this shape as untouched), but [x](<https://ipfs.io/ipfs/%41<cid>/a b.png>) is rewritten to https://gw/ipfs/A<cid>/a%20b.png: the space makes RawPath invalid, EscapedPath falls back to escape(Path) with %41 decoded, and validIPFSName accepts 'A<cid>'.
